# Cinder Rack Converter

## Architecture

Cinder converts an 800 V DC bus to 48 V with an input-series, output-parallel architecture.

The isolated modules use gallium-nitride switches and operate at 500 kHz.

## Performance

The 5.5 kW converter reaches 98.4% peak efficiency at half load.
